fnol_text: My name is Priya Santos and I live at 686 Larkspur Court, Riverton, WY 82595. You can reach me on (555) 918-6425 or priya.santos@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 4 November 2025 when the car behind, driven by Arjun Kaminski, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2025-00030. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Santos on (555) 918-6425 to acknowledge the claim. Priya confirmed the loss date as 4 November 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Jordan Ballard gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Arjun Kaminski reports a mild concussion and attended Mercy General. Priya reports a sprained ankle.
